podcast:liveItem.title: Jorfest 2026
podcast:liveItem.description:
Somewhere around 7 PM Central on Saturday, the lights along Jorbear’s roofline are going to change color, and if you watch closely you’ll notice they’re not lights at all. They’re pixels. They always were. The house is a sprite. The yard is a level. We’re Here, Sam Lofthus and NoName are about to take the decks, and you are invited to watch in the glow and admit, finally, that this is new.

The value lies within splits. Every sat you send gets divided eight ways, evenly, among the people building the world in front of you. No landlord. No platform skimming off the top. Just a bunch of humans passing energy around a circle. That’s not a business model, that’s a campfire.

Pixel Palace: Jorfest 2026
Saturday, October 17 · 7–10 PM CT · 00:00–03:00 UTC (Oct 18)
DJs: We’re Here, Sam Lofthus, NoName
Reporter on the ground: Frankiepaint

Boost, and the last digit summons one of ten stuffed animals. Milestone art appears as the sat count crosses 25k, 50k and 100k.

ericpp’s scripts turn the producer’s split kit input into OSC commands for Jorbear’s grandMA3 and Onyx consoles and boo-bury’s video switcher. When the split changes, the camera cuts and that zone’s lighting comes up with it. No boost required.

Watch: https://www.pixelpalace.party/
Also live on Nostr: https://primal.net/p/nprofile1qqsr5qnsn6medetj3vexljqqvy99gfdrgsp7hs9f52kdvrryz6gwkrsxg6l7w
